# `gcp.subscription`

A named resource representing the stream of messages from a single, specific topic, to be delivered to the subscribing application.

[pubsub](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | pubsub |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `pubsub.googleapis.com/Subscription` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: The same two request shapes as pubsub/Topic -- a PUT create to the subscription's own path, which keeps `name` out of the body, and UpdateSubscriptionRequest{subscription, updateMask} as the update -- plus one hook about the mask.
pre_update (pre_update/pubsub_subscription.go.tmpl) adds `bigqueryConfig` to the update mask WHENEVER a BigQuery config is set, changed or not, "so that the bigquery service account email can be updated properly". BuildMask names only what changed, so an update that leaves bigqueryConfig alone does not resend it.
THE BOUNDED GAP: a BigQuery subscription whose writer service account Google rotates is not nudged by an unrelated update. Setting or changing bigqueryConfig still sends it in full, which is the case the field exists for. And `name` is the full resource name, as for pubsub/Topic.
) |
| Mutation timeout | 60s |
